_comment: Example thresholds for development. SLA thresholds are public under ADR-0017; backend credentials remain references and must not be committed. Shares schema_version + provenance.kb_git_commit with catalog.tr-virt-007.json so they join.

sla.condition: after unplanned node failure: volume re-attach + VM restart on a surviving node

checks.name: Node-failure VM recovery
checks.expectation: all VMs recover to Running+Ready on surviving nodes; ping restored

checks.name: Volume re-attach on failover is prompt and correct
